eps.o: An adventurous couple looks to move back to their hometown of Kansas City, Missouri. She's after a major renovation to make their next home unique, but after eight prior project houses, he wants move-in ready.

A couple's ready to trade their small apartment for a home with a dojo for MMA training in Knoxville, Tennessee. He wants a big house with as much space as they can get, but she prefers a cozy cottage that leaves room in the budget for their wedding.

eps.t: Just Get Her in the Door
eps.o: A husband's biggest challenge in buying a first home in Pennsylvania is getting his picky wife through the front door. He's after a modern townhome, but after living in 35 apartments as a kid, she's refusing to settle for anything but a house.

Best friends attached at the hip are determined to find two homes right next to each other outside Dallas. Finding homes for sale that are also neighboring is enough of a challenge, but their differing tastes and price ranges might make it impossible.

A budget-conscious single mom is leaning on AI to make a smart home purchase in Jacksonville, Florida. She wants a move-in ready townhouse, but her cousin is pushing her to stop penny-pinching and see beyond the data to imagine her next chapter.

An Air Force JAG lawyer and a stay-at-home dad clash over their search for a permanent home near Washington, DC. She wants move-in ready and a good commute, but he loves a project and wants to tinker endlessly on lots of land. English

An Ohio couple who have relocated to California are ready to find their next home. They need a larger place with room to entertain, and she wants sweeping ocean views, but his main concern is having space for his robots to battle.

A single mom convinces her family to go in together on a large, upgraded home in North Carolina. She's looking for a level of luxury she feels she's earned, but after three years of searching with no agreement, there may be too many cooks in this kitchen.
